ValidationRule.description: to make sure the user fills all mandatory fields when they select complaint has third issue
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Complaint', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Non_Customer_Complaint' ), OR ( AND( IDR_Third_Issue__c, OR( ISBLANK(TEXT(IDR_Issue_Type_3__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(IDR_Subsequent_Issue_3__c)), ISBLANK(IDR_Product_3__c), (ISBLANK(IDR_Account_Card_Policy_Number_3__c) && RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Complaint') ) ), AND( NOT(IDR_Third_Issue__c), OR( ISCHANGED(IDR_Issue_Type_3__c), ISCHANGED(IDR_Subsequent_Issue_3__c), ISCHANGED(IDR_Product_3__c), ISCHANGED(IDR_Account_Card_Policy_Number_3__c) ) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: All fields in the Third Issue section are mandatory if the complaint has third issue
